local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local GameConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameConfig"))

local DataService = {}
local PlayerData = {}
local GameDataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("CandyCyberpunk_v1")

function DataService:Init()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		self:LoadData(player)
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		self:SaveData(player)
		PlayerData[player.UserId] = nil
	end)
end

function DataService:LoadData(player)
	local success, data = pcall(function()
		return GameDataStore:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[DataService] Error loading data for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(data))
	end

	if success and data then
		PlayerData[player.UserId] = data
	else
		PlayerData[player.UserId] = {
			Candy = GameConfig.StartingCandy,
			Coins = GameConfig.StartingCoins,
			Rebirths = GameConfig.startingRebirths,
			Inventory = {},
			EquippedPets = {},
			UnlockedZones = { "Candy Neon City" }
		}
	end

	-- Create leaderstats
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local candy = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	candy.Name = "Candy"
	candy.Value = PlayerData[player.UserId].Candy
	candy.Parent = leaderstats

	local coins = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Value = PlayerData[player.UserId].Coins
	coins.Parent = leaderstats
	
	candy.Changed:Connect(function(val) PlayerData[player.UserId].Candy = val end)
	coins.Changed:Connect(function(val) PlayerData[player.UserId].Coins = val end)
end

function DataService:SaveData(player)
	if PlayerData[player.UserId] then
		pcall(function()
			GameDataStore:SetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, PlayerData[player.UserId])
		end)
	end
end

function DataService:Get(player)
	return PlayerData[player.UserId]
end

function DataService:Update(player, key, value)
	if PlayerData[player.UserId] and PlayerData[player.UserId][key] ~= nil then
		PlayerData[player.UserId][key] = value
		local leader = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		if leader and leader:FindFirstChild(key) then
			leader[key].Value = value
		end
	end
end

return DataService

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local GameConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameConfig"))
local ServiceFramework = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("ServiceFramework"))

local PetService = {}
local SpawnedPets = {} -- PlayerUserId -> {Model}

function PetService:Init()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		SpawnedPets[player.UserId] = {}
	end)
	
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		self:CleanupPets(player)
		SpawnedPets[player.UserId] = nil
	end)
end

function PetService:CleanupPets(player)
	if SpawnedPets[player.UserId] then
		for _, pet in ipairs(SpawnedPets[player.UserId]) do
			pet:Destroy()
		end
		SpawnedPets[player.UserId] = {}
	end
end

function PetService:GivePet(player, petName)
	local dataService = ServiceFramework:GetService("DataService")
	local playerData = dataService:Get(player)
	
	local petInfo = nil
	for _, p in ipairs(GameConfig.Pets) do
		if p.Name == petName then
			petInfo = p
			break
		end
	end
	
	if petInfo then
		table.insert(playerData.Inventory, {
			Name = petInfo.Name,
			Rarity = petInfo.Rarity,
			UUID = game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
		})
		-- For now, auto-equip if possible
		if #playerData.EquippedPets < 3 then
			table.insert(playerData.EquippedPets, playerData.Inventory[#playerData.Inventory].UUID)
			self:SpawnPetsForPlayer(player)
		end
	end
end

function PetService:SpawnPetsForPlayer(player)
	self:CleanupPets(player)
	
	local playerData = ServiceFramework:GetService("DataService"):Get(player)
	for i, uuid in ipairs(playerData.EquippedPets) do
		local petData = nil
		for _, p in ipairs(playerData.Inventory) do
			if p.UUID == uuid then
				petData = p
				break
			end
		end
		
		if petData then
			local petModel = self:CreatePetModel(petData.Name, petData.Rarity)
			petModel.Name = "Pet_" .. player.Name .. "_" .. i
			petModel:SetAttribute("Owner", player.UserId)
			petModel:SetAttribute("Slot", i)
			petModel.Parent = workspace
			table.insert(SpawnedPets[player.UserId], petModel)
		end
	end
end

function PetService:CreatePetModel(name, rarity)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	part.Color = GameConfig.PetRarities[rarity].Color
	
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = part
	
	-- Add visual flair base on rarity
	if rarity == "Legendary" then
		local particle = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		particle.Texture = "rbxassetid://111803940069577" -- Star
		particle.Color = ColorSequence.new(GameConfig.PetRarities[rarity].Color)
		particle.Rate = 20
		particle.Parent = part
	end
	
	return part
end

return PetService

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local GameConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameConfig"))
local ServiceFramework = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("ServiceFramework"))

local ZoneService = {}

function ZoneService:Init()
	self:SetupZones()
end

function ZoneService:SetupZones()
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Zones"
	folder.Parent = workspace
	
	for i, zone in ipairs(GameConfig.Zones) do
		local zoneModel = Instance.new("Model")
		zoneModel.Name = zone.Name
		zoneModel.Parent = folder
		
		-- Simple representation: A gate/portal
		local gate = Instance.new("Part")
		gate.Name = "Gate"
		gate.Size = Vector3.new(20, 15, 2)
		gate.Position = Vector3.new(0, 7.5, i * 150)
		gate.Anchored = true
		gate.CanCollide = (zone.Cost > 0)
		gate.Transparency = (zone.Cost > 0) and 0.5 or 1
		gate.Color = zone.Color
		gate.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		gate.Parent = zoneModel
		
		if zone.Cost > 0 then
			local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
			prompt.ObjectText = zone.Name
			prompt.ActionText = "Unlock for " .. zone.Cost .. " Coins"
			prompt.HoldDuration = 1.5
			prompt.Parent = gate
			
			prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
				self:TryUnlockZone(player, zone.Name)
			end)
		end
	end
end

function ZoneService:TryUnlockZone(player, zoneName)
	local dataService = ServiceFramework:GetService("DataService")
	local playerData = dataService:Get(player)
	
	local zoneInfo = nil
	for _, z in ipairs(GameConfig.Zones) do
		if z.Name == zoneName then
			zoneInfo = z
			break
		end
	end
	
	if zoneInfo and not table.find(playerData.UnlockedZones, zoneName) then
		if playerData.Coins >= zoneInfo.Cost then
			dataService:Update(player, "Coins", playerData.Coins - zoneInfo.Cost)
			table.insert(playerData.UnlockedZones, zoneName)
			print("[ZoneService] " .. player.Name .. " unlocked " .. zoneName)
			-- Logic to open gate locally or globally
		end
	end
end

return ZoneService

function DataService:Init()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		self:LoadData(player)
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		self:SaveData(player)
		PlayerData[player.UserId] = nil
	end)
end

function DataService:LoadData(player)
	local success, data = pcall(function()
		return GameDataStore:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[DataService] Error loading data for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(data))
	end

	if success and data then
		PlayerData[player.UserId] = data
	else
		PlayerData[player.UserId] = {
			Candy = GameConfig.StartingCandy,
			Coins = GameConfig.StartingCoins,
			Rebirths = GameConfig.startingRebirths,
			Inventory = {},
			EquippedPets = {},
			UnlockedZones = { "Candy Neon City" }
		}
	end

	-- Create leaderstats
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local candy = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	candy.Name = "Candy"
	candy.Value = PlayerData[player.UserId].Candy
	candy.Parent = leaderstats

	local coins = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Value = PlayerData[player.UserId].Coins
	coins.Parent = leaderstats
	
	candy.Changed:Connect(function(val) PlayerData[player.UserId].Candy = val end)
	coins.Changed:Connect(function(val) PlayerData[player.UserId].Coins = val end)
end

function DataService:SaveData(player)
	if PlayerData[player.UserId] then
		pcall(function()
			GameDataStore:SetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, PlayerData[player.UserId])
		end)
	end
end

function DataService:Get(player)
	return PlayerData[player.UserId]
end

function DataService:Update(player, key, value)
	if PlayerData[player.UserId] and PlayerData[player.UserId][key] ~= nil then
		PlayerData[player.UserId][key] = value
		local leader = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		if leader and leader:FindFirstChild(key) then
			leader[key].Value = value
		end
	end
end

return DataService
